name: mesh-wars
description: MESH WARS: Frontier Traders. The game itself needs no build; this tooling only regenerates character.js from src/character.

scripts.build: esbuild src/character/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=CharacterKit --target=es2020 --outfile=character.js --banner:js="/* MESH WARS CharacterKit - GENERATED from src/character by 'npm run build'. Do not edit by hand. */"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
